verified: Eight October incidents reported by GitHub
October 7 two write outages caused by stale retired-server records published after database routing leader election
October 29 regional Azure network disruption affected three Central US availability zones and at least 34,128 signed-in users
140 of 151 production services in Azure Central US as November 9
limits: Different incidents have different causes; do not attribute all to Azure or migration
